tools.name: skavio_launch_status
tools.description: Free production availability status, including explicitly disabled processing functions. No execution or charge. Returns activation and owner-funded historical payment journal evidence separately from approved pricing and unverified realized profitability.

tools.name: skavio_catalog
tools.description: Free discovery of Skavio paid MCP tools, prices, and networks. No access to customer data. Returns four paid prices in USDC, inspection networks, separate processing authentication and activation limits. No call submits a job or spends funds.

tools.name: verify_native_usdc
tools.description: Inspect a completed native Circle USDC transfer by transaction hash on a supported chain (Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Ethereum, Avalanche or Solana). Use for transaction evidence; use match_native_usdc_payment to require an exact recipient and six-decimal amount, or usdc_transfer_evidence_pdf

tools.name: match_native_usdc_payment
tools.description: Confirm an exact native Circle USDC recipient and six-decimal transfer amount for a completed transaction on a supported EVM chain or Solana, with chain-specific finality checks. Use when reconciling a payment with an expected wallet and amount; for inspecting a transfer without expected values choo

tools.name: usdc_transfer_evidence_pdf
tools.description: Generate a bounded base64-encoded PDF containing publicly verifiable native Circle USDC transaction evidence for an existing on-chain transfer. Use when a customer or accountant needs a downloadable blockchain proof, not when you need a machine-readable exact recipient and amount check (use match_na

tools.name: domain_dns_tls_audit
tools.description: Audit the public DNS records and TLS certificate of ONE public hostname, using bounded DNS resolution and a TLS handshake to port 443. Use for a basic hostname/certificate check; do not use for web content fetching (web_fetch), page extraction (web_extract), vulnerability scanning, port scanning or

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Retrieve content from a public HTTPS document under robots.txt, SSRF and byte limits. Use for a source fetch; choose web_extract when only human-visible text is needed and web_monitor for content change hashes. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API

tools.name: web_extract
tools.description: Extract human-visible text from one public HTTPS page under robots and size limits. Use for readable page text, not raw document fetching (web_fetch) or SHA256 change detection (web_monitor). This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API key, an enabled ba

tools.name: web_monitor
tools.description: Measure a public HTTPS page's content hash, optionally comparing the previous SHA256 supplied by the caller. Use for detecting changes; choose web_fetch to retrieve the document or web_extract for just visible text. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Beare

tools.name: pdf_to_text
tools.description: Extract embedded selectable text from a PDF supplied as base64. Use for text-layer PDFs; use document_ocr when pages are scanned images, and invoice_extract for structured invoice fields. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API key, an enabled backen

tools.name: document_ocr
tools.description: Apply optical character recognition to a scanned document supplied as base64 and return searchable extracted text. Use when the document lacks a usable text layer; use pdf_to_text for selectable PDF text and invoice_extract for invoice fields. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools r

tools.name: invoice_extract
tools.description: Extract structured invoice fields from one uploaded document, with source page count verified and a per-page cost quote. Use for invoice metadata, not generic OCR (document_ocr) or plain selectable text (pdf_to_text). This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bea

tools.name: audio_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe a bounded source audio or video file supplied as base64 to text. Use for spoken media; not for OCR, invoice parsing, or PDF content conversion. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API key, an enabled backend operation and an accepted payme

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Select one-based page numbers from an uploaded PDF and return a new document containing those pages. Use to extract pages; use pdf_merge to concatenate two to five whole PDFs or pdf_to_text for reading text. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API ke

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Combine two to five uploaded base64-encoded PDF documents into one output document, preserving the supplied order. Use to concatenate files; use pdf_split to select pages from one PDF or pdf_to_text to extract text. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Beare

tools.name: skavio_agent_job_status
tools.description: Read your owned processing job and result manifest; no new payment. Input is your original idempotency key. Returns state, reservation, availability and any owned result IDs; only available results may be downloaded.

tools.name: skavio_agent_job_result
tools.description: Download your owned completed processing result as base64 with SHA256; no new payment. Input result_id must come from your completed owned manifest. Returns data_base64, sha256 and delivered=true, or an explicit error; independently verify the checksum.

tools.name: skavio_agent_wallet
tools.description: Read your authoritative shared credit wallet; no new payment. Returns balance_credits, available_credits, reserved_credits and USD display strings with ledger_source. It does not fund, reserve, move or spend credits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_dns_tls_audit · Private data: verify_native_usdc, match_native_usdc_payment, domain_dns_tls_audit, web_fetch, web_extract, web_monitor, pdf_to_text, document_ocr, invoice_extract, audio_transcribe, pdf_split, pdf_merge, skavio_agent_wallet · Public sink: match_native_usdc_payment, domain_dns_tls_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_dns_tls_audit · Private data: verify_native_usdc, match_native_usdc_payment, domain_dns_tls_audit, web_fetch, web_extract, web_monitor, pdf_to_text, document_ocr, invoice_extract, audio_transcribe, pdf_split, pdf_merge, skavio_agent_wallet · Public sink: match_native_usdc_payment, domain_dns_tls_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
